impact: The new module is 2,670 lines with 72 top-level functions and five classes, combining PDF graph canonicalization, manifest schemas, layout measurement, subprocess supervision, raster/image generation, filesystem security, evidence storage, locking, retention, and CLI dispatch. A change such as adding a manifest field requires navigating generation, validation, migration, promotion, and storage code in one file, increasing coupling and the chance of incomplete edits. I inspected the full module organization and function/caller inventory; these responsibilities are not separated behind cohesive modules.
